mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_monitor_result ( monitor_result_id, monitor_task_id, ingest_record_id, title, content, original_url, platform, author_name, publish_time, matched_subjects, matched_keywords, matched_negative_words, sentiment, risk_level, risk_score, school_relevance_score, school_relevance_reason, matched_school_terms, excluded_reason, topic_category, topic_sub_category, topic_reason, result_status, alert_id, clue_id, language, like_count, comment_count, share_count, collect_count, view_count, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id ) VALUES ( #{monitorResultId}, #{monitorTaskId}, #{ingestRecordId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{originalUrl}, #{platform}, #{authorName}, #{publishTime}, #{matchedSubjects}, #{matchedKeywords}, #{matchedNegativeWords}, #{sentiment}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskScore}, #{schoolRelevanceScore}, #{schoolRelevanceReason}, #{matchedSchoolTerms}, #{excludedReason}, #{topicCategory}, #{topicSubCategory}, #{topicReason}, #{resultStatus}, #{alertId}, #{clueId}, #{language}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{shareCount}, #{collectCount}, #{viewCount}, #{deleted}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId} )

UPDATE campus_monitor_result SET title = CASE WHEN #{record.title} IS NOT NULL AND #{record.title} != '' AND (title IS NULL OR title = '') THEN #{record.title} ELSE title END, content = CASE WHEN #{record.content} IS NOT NULL AND #{record.content} != '' AND (content IS NULL OR content = '' OR CHAR_LENGTH(content) < CHAR_LENGTH(#{record.content})) THEN #{record.content} ELSE content END, original_url = CASE WHEN #{record.originalUrl} IS NOT NULL AND #{record.originalUrl} != '' AND (original_url IS NULL OR original_url = '') THEN #{record.originalUrl} ELSE original_url END, platform = CASE WHEN #{record.platform} IS NOT NULL AND #{record.platform} != '' AND (platform IS NULL OR platform = '') THEN #{record.platform} ELSE platform END, author_name = CASE WHEN #{record.authorName} IS NOT NULL AND #{record.authorName} != '' AND (author_name IS NULL OR author_name = '') THEN #{record.authorName} ELSE author_name END, publish_time = CASE WHEN publish_time IS NULL THEN #{record.publishTime} ELSE publish_time END, language = CASE WHEN #{record.language} IS NOT NULL AND #{record.language} != '' AND (language IS NULL OR language = '') THEN #{record.language} ELSE language END, like_count = CASE WHEN #{record.likeCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{record.likeCount} ELSE like_count END, comment_count = CASE WHEN #{record.commentCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{record.commentCount} ELSE comment_count END, share_count = CASE WHEN #{record.shareCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{record.shareCount} ELSE share_count END, collect_count = CASE WHEN #{record.collectCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{record.collectCount} ELSE collect_count END, view_count = CASE WHEN #{record.viewCount} IS NOT NULL THEN #{record.viewCount} ELSE view_count END, update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE monitor_result_id = #{monitorResultId} AND deleted = 0
